findings.title: Production relational databases must be resilient
findings.rationale: Production relational data stores must tolerate an availability-zone failure.
findings.impact: AZ failure may cause complete database outage.
findings.remediation: Enable multi-AZ or provide documented equivalent resilience.

findings.title: Workloads must not use mutable latest tags

findings.title: Production workloads should run multiple replicas

findings.impact: Single-replica production workloads are single points of failure.
findings.remediation: Increase replicas or document accepted risk with a waiver.
